title: Heart of Darkness
author: Joseph Conrad
summary: Sailor Marlow tells his shipmates about a steamboat trip up the Congo to find Kurtz, a trader who has become a legend. What he sees on the way shows him what the ivory trade has made of the people involved.
readIf: you want a short, dense, atmospheric classic about colonialism and moral collapse.
skipIf: you would struggle with its racist language and attitudes, which are the subject of ongoing criticism.

pairings.reason: Another short classic about how thin the line is between order and savagery.
A modern novel about a family in colonial-era Congo, told from several women's points of view.
The African novel written partly in response, showing the same period from the inside.
